backend/main.mo: Motoko actor that manages investment leads with CRUD operations, storing leads in a Set with fields like fundCategory and investmentRange, and providing query methods for filtering, statistics, and pagination.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (blue color theme update, global funds section, contact detail updates) to their affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose and key implementation details for the Planinvestgrow mutual fund advisor app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes used by shadcn/ui components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that sets the page title to 'Planinvestgrow - Mutual Fund Advisor' and mounts the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with a shared layout (Navigation, Footer, Toaster) and two routes: HomePage (/) and DashboardPage (/dashboard).
frontend/src/components/AdvisorProfile.t: Advisor profile section displaying Darshit Sheth's portrait, credentials, specializations, and contact details (shethdarshit@live.com, Vadodara) with navy blue theme and floating stat cards.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with navy-950 background displaying brand info, contact details (shethdarshit@live.com, Vadodara, Gujarat, India), quick links, and fund category list with gold accent styling.
frontend/src/components/FundCategoriesSe: Renders a grid of mutual fund category cards (Global, Technology, Healthcare, Infrastructure, Real Estate, Renewable Energy) with risk levels, return ranges, and tags. Accepts an `onInvestClick` callback for CTA buttons.
frontend/src/components/GlobalFundsSecti: Displays a marketing section highlighting Darshit Sheth's unique global/international mutual fund expertise, featuring four differentiator cards and a CTA button.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a background image, trust badges, advisor bio, key stats, and a CTA button that triggers the lead form scroll via `onCtaClick`.
frontend/src/components/LeadForm.tsx: A consultation request form with fields for name, email, phone, city, fund category, investment range, and message; submits via `useSubmitLead` mutation and shows toast notifications on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with logo, desktop and mobile nav links (Home, Advisor Dashboard), and a 'Book Free Consultation' button that smoothly scrolls to the lead form.
frontend/src/components/WhyInvestSection: Renders a section showcasing seven benefits of mutual fund investing in India (SIP, ELSS, SEBI regulation, diversification, returns, ESG, liquidity) as a responsive card grid with icons and tags.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates all dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching leads, lead count, and fund category statistics from the backend, plus a mutation hook for submitting new leads.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, configures Tailwind, and defines CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens (navy/gold theme) in both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with React Query's QueryClientProvider and the InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page that displays a searchable, filterable table of consultation leads alongside summary stat cards (total leads, top category) fetched from the ICP backend.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Composes the public-facing landing page by assembling Hero, GlobalFunds, WhyInvest, FundCategories, AdvisorProfile, and LeadForm sections, with a shared smooth-scroll handler targeting the lead form.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom fonts (Inter, Playfair Display), oklch-based color tokens (navy, gold, and semantic UI colors), dark mode support, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing a mutual fund advisor website for Darshit Sheth (Planinvestgrow.com), including architectural notes, branding guidelines, image requirements, and a list of existing and planned features for the Indian financial market.
